patch.role: Exception fallback in style_for_token: on a missing cache entry, rebuild it from the parent entry when the token declares no own style.

inputs.mask_text: standard token whose declared style is empty
inputs.mask_name_other: token with no own declaration, inherits its parent entry
inputs.expose_keyword: token with its own style declaration (fallback re-raises)
inputs.mask_operator_inherited: another token without its own declaration; A executes and the fallback masks it

rationale: A inserts the resolved style into the class-level shared cache consumed by style_for_token.  U1 catches the resulting KeyError and rebuilds the entry from the parent.  Tokens with their own style declarations are outside the declared fallback and expose the deletion.
